consequence.statement: ClusterExternalSecret v1beta1 resources with spec.externalSecretSpec.target.template.engineVersion set to "v1" are rejected by the API server.
consequence.remediation: Change engineVersion to a value still allowed by the schema before upgrading.

original.statement: The v1beta1 ClusterExternalSecret schema no longer allows "v1" for spec.externalSecretSpec.target.template.engineVersion, so resources setting it are rejected.

decision.reason: The CRD bundles for v0.15.0 [ev-9889c9b8706d] and v0.16.0 [ev-e08924afdc47] were compared by a validator, which confirmed that the v1beta1 ClusterExternalSecret enum for spec.externalSecretSpec.target.template.engineVersion lost "v1" and gained no values. The computed change says a removed enum value is rejected by the API server. So ClusterExternalSecret v1beta1 resources that set engineVersion to "v1" are rejected, and resource-rejected (action) is the right consequence. Nothing in the evidence argues against the proposed severity.
